# NocoBase UI Library catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-ui-library-catalog.mjs from ui-library/registry. Do not edit: change the item’s registry.json, then run `node scripts/gen-ui-library-catalog.mjs`. -->

A compact index of the `@nocobase` shadcn registry (the NocoBase UI Library, previewed at https://ui.nocobase.com) as of this release of the Skill. Look an item up live first, as [section 3 of `styling.md`](styling.md#3-use-shadcn) says, and use this list when the registry cannot be reached.

- Install: `yes n | pnpm exec shadcn add @nocobase/<item>`. A component installs into `client/components/`, a block into `client/extensions/nocobase-<item>/`; an entry names any other location.
- Before using an item, read its description, wiring notes and plugin requirements with `pnpm exec shadcn view @nocobase/<item>`, and its usage example `@nocobase/<item>-demo` (every item has one unless its entry says otherwise).
- An item that names plugins needs them registered (`pnpm nocobase plugin register <name>`).

## Agents

- `agent-queue` (block): An agent work queue: one lane per agent with the run in progress, what comes next and why it waits, and what waits for a person.
- `agent-run-history` (component): An agent's runs on one subject: a compact side-column log with a live timer, an all-runs dialog, the live pill, an activity row, a run's transcript and its brief.
- `agent-composer` (component): The message box for talking to an agent: page-context chips inside it (each can open a preview of what it carries), files to send (attach, paste, drop, uploaded before sending), Enter to send, Stop while the agent works, and a toolbar slot for a picker such as the agent's. Plugins: `@nocobase/app-plugin-agents`, `@nocobase/app-plugin-file`.
- `agent-picker` (component): The one way to pick an agent: a trigger with the agent's avatar (availability dot on its corner) and name, and a menu of every enabled agent with what it is good at, its default and "personal runners only" tags, and why one cannot answer the viewer now (it cannot be picked then). Plugins: `@nocobase/app-plugin-agents`.
- `agent-chat` (block): A simple agent conversation panel with shared page/panel headers, history, composer and launchers. Plugins: `@nocobase/app-plugin-agents`, `@nocobase/app-plugin-file`.
- `agent-chat-details` (block): The agent chat workspace: the conversation list, one conversation and its details (linked work such as tasks, context usage, runtime and agent), laid out by its own width as one column, list beside conversation, or list, conversation and details. Installs to `client/extensions/nocobase-agent-chat/`.

## Approval

- `approval-ui` (block): Presentational approval components: a request's progress through its stages with vote tallies, its history, the route a new request would take, parallel branches as a whole, a notice's receipts, and a bar of the actions the person may take.

## Authentication

- `auth-forms` (block): Password sign-in, sign-up, reset-request and reset forms.
- `auth-methods` (block): Switches between several sign-in methods in tabs and lists single sign-on providers below them.
- `auth-centered-layout` (block): The page around an authentication form: the brand above a card in the middle of a muted page.
- `auth-split-layout` (block): The page around an authentication form: the form on the left and the application's own content on the right of a wide screen.
- `device-approval` (block): The /device page where a signed-in person approves or denies the sign-in of a CLI or another device (RFC 8628 device authorization). Plugins: `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication`.

## Authorization

- `permission-editor` (component): A controlled permission workspace with top category tabs, application-owned menu paths, compact action groups, status filtering and independent data scopes.
- `role-list` (component): A role administration table built with the standard DataTable: localized column headers, sortable names and identifiers, protected/custom badges, and pagination.
- `default-access-editor` (component): Controlled default data scope fields grouped by operation, with independently named ranges and native custom-filter slots.

## Data display

- `record-link` (component): A native router link for record names and identifiers in tables and lists: foreground text at rest, underline on hover and visible keyboard focus.
- `kanban` (component): A generic board: columns of cards dragged within and between columns, reporting each move through a callback.
- `markdown-view` (component): The shared Markdown renderer: GitHub-flavoured Markdown as compact prose with mention chips, sanitised URLs, #anchor links on the page and every other link in a new tab.
- `long-text` (component): A long text shown in part, the last line fading out instead of an ellipsis.
- `comment-thread` (component): A record's activity line: comment threads with reactions, reply, edit, delete and resolve, the consumer's own entries between them, and a composer with modes and files.
- `attachment-list` (component): Files on a record or a message: image thumbnails and file chips with download, the files waiting to be sent, and a section that takes uploads.

## Data entry

- `property-fields` (component): The fields of a record's property card: the titled card, label and value rows, a select, chips with creation, a date, a number, a line of text, a long text, a link, a person as a value, and a row of avatars.
- `rich-text-editor` (component): A Markdown-in, Markdown-out rich text editor on official Tiptap extensions, with a composable toolbar, @mentions from an async search, pasted or dropped uploads, and room for your own extensions.

## Diagrams

- `flow-diagram` (component): Read-only React Flow canvas with ELK orthogonal routing for directed graphs, including branches, cycles, parallel edges and self-loops.
- `lifecycle-diagram` (component): Theme-aware, read-only lifecycle diagram using React Flow and ELK.

## Feedback

- `loading` (component): Region-owned loading feedback with delayed display and long-wait guidance.
- `pending-button` (component): A stable-size native action button with immediate busy semantics and delayed feedback.
- `task-progress` (component): One long-running task record: real determinate progress, honest indeterminate waiting, failure, result and background continuation.

## File

- `file-component-ui` (block): Application-owned upload, list, thumbnail, and preview components for business file endpoints. Plugins: `@nocobase/app-plugin-file`.

## Forms

- `feedback-form` (component): Preserves form input, maps safe field errors and focuses the first editable error in layout order.

## Inbox

- `inbox` (block): The /inbox page over @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app: a master–detail list with All and To do views, a kind filter, cards clickable anywhere with a chevron, read, unread and delete, one detail header for every kind whose title links to the message's page, with the decision's buttons right under it, j / k navigation and realtime refresh. Plugins: `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app`.
- `inbox-button` (component): A header button linking to the inbox, with an amber badge for what waits on the viewer or the unread count, its tooltip, and the browser tab title prefix.

## Notification

- `notification-logs-ui` (block): Application-owned delivery and provider attempt log components backed by the NocoBase notification API.

## Other

- `data-table` (component): Standard TanStack Table v8 table with controlled server pagination and sorting, selection and column visibility.
- `list-feedback` (component): Accessible list loading, empty, filtered, permission and request feedback for tables and cards.

## Page layout

- `page-container` (component): The frame of a page: full width, responsive padding, and the spacing between its sections.
- `page-header` (component): The heading of a page: its title, an optional description, and page-level actions.
- `settings-dialog` (component): A settings dialog after shadcn's sidebar-13: grouped categories in a sidebar on the left, the open one on the right, a scrolling row on a phone.
- `setup-readiness` (component): Contextual prerequisite checks for a feature, with missing, ready and unavailable states.

## Projects

- `issue-table` (component): The issues list: identifier, title with labels, status drawn as its shape, priority, owner (a person or an agent's avatar), project and last update, with sorting, selection, extra columns, group rows and a compact phone layout through props and callbacks. Plugins: `@nocobase/app-plugin-agents`, `@nocobase/app-plugin-projects`.
- `issue-card` (component): One issue, compact: identifier, title, status in its workflow colour, priority, owner and executor (person or agent), due date and labels, as a one-line row for lists or a stacked card for boards; one link or button, with slots for marks and trailing actions, and a loading skeleton.
- `issue-detail` (block): An issue's page as presentational parts: the two-column frame of cards on the page background, the header and description opening the body card, an add bar under it, the secondary parts (sub-issues, dependencies with an issue search, files) as sections sharing one heading pattern and hidden while empty, files dropped or pasted on the body, and the side column over property-fields.
- `project-detail` (block): A project's page as presentational parts: the header with progress, the overview's numbers, status distribution, description and members, the working directories (each linking to its settings page, with a row menu and an empty state), members and visibility settings, and the unreleased changes and previews.
- `plan-card` (block): An operation plan of @nocobase/app-plugin-projects as a card: the issues it is about, its changes row by row with whom each wakes and what it risks, execute with a second confirmation for risky rows, void, check again, undo within the window after a preview, and an in-place editor of an open plan's rows over property-fields; a frame prop lays its parts out under a header of the caller's, such as an inbox detail pane's. Plugins: `@nocobase/app-plugin-projects`.

## Route overlays

- `route-dialog` (component): A child route presented as a centered modal dialog, opened and closed by its URL.
- `route-drawer` (component): A child route presented as a modal panel at the right edge, opened and closed by its URL.
- `route-child-page` (component): A child route presented as a non-modal page covering the content area, keeping the page beneath mounted.

## Task Center

- `task-center-ui` (block): Presentational components for a personal task center layered as source → subject → status → task cards: a source navigation with subjects folded under each source, pending counts and a client-side subject search; To do / Done / All tabs; day-grouped task cards whose summary each task type contributes; one-type-at-a-time batch selection with a floating action bar and confirmation; and a right-side detail drawer whose form and actions the task's business supplies.

## Workflows

- `workflow-management` (block): Workflow administration as presentational parts: one management page with Definitions and Executions tabs, a categorized definition list, a filtered execution list, definition diagram and parameter layout, and execution history inspection beside a diagram.
